dialogue.chandler.work.identity/1: I make the light this village goes to bed by. Tallow mostly, beeswax when I can get it.
dialogue.chandler.work.identity/2: Candles, %1$s. Every household on this lane burns something I poured.
dialogue.chandler.work.hard/1: Getting the wick right. Too thick and it gutters, too thin and it drowns in its own wax.
dialogue.chandler.work.hard/2: The waiting, %1$s. A batch that will not set cannot be hurried, and winter does not care.
dialogue.chandler.respond.value: The whole lane would notice if you stopped.
dialogue.chandler.work.value/1: They would notice in about four days, which is when the last of the stock runs out.
dialogue.chandler.work.value/2: It is a quiet sort of useful. Nobody thanks the candle, they thank the light.
dialogue.chandler.respond.challenge: Tallow smokes and stinks, and you know it.
dialogue.chandler.work.challenge.landed/: It does. That is why the good stuff costs what it costs, and why you buy the cheap stuff anyway.
Smokes, stinks, burns all night for a copper. Pick two, %1$s.
dialogue.chandler.work.challenge.stung/1: Then buy beeswax and pay for it. I will wait.
dialogue.chandler.work.challenge.stung/2: Everyone is an expert on candles until the dark comes early.
dialogue.chandler.work.leave/1: Aye. The moulds will not fill themselves.
dialogue.chandler.work.leave/2: Mind the drips on your way past.
dialogue.chandler.followup.ask_more: Is there anything you refuse to make?
dialogue.chandler.work.more/1: Nothing black, and nothing for the sort of gathering that wants nothing black.
dialogue.chandler.work.more/2: I will not pour for a house that has not paid for the last lot, %1$s. That is the whole list.
dialogue.chandler.followup.thanks: I had not thought of it that way.
dialogue.chandler.work.thanks/1: Most people do not. That is rather the trade.
dialogue.chandler.work.thanks/2: It is a good hour when somebody looks at the candle instead of past it.
dialogue.chandler.work.followup.leave/1: Right. Good talking, and now the moulds.
